title: Length of Compiled Calls
statement: Let $G$ be a code layout, $p\in\mathbb N$ a procedure index, $args$ a finite list of expressions, and $r\in\mathbb N$ a return position. The compiled call, which compiles the arguments, constructs a new frame of width $G.F$, and branches to the indexed procedure entry (or position $0$ if no such entry exists), has length $\sum_{e\in args}\mathrm{size}(e)+1+2G.F+4$.

a return position r in ℕ
